title: Matched-Exposure Development Qualification v1
description: Stage-specific structural schema and closed type-descriptor registry for PRE_RANKING DEVELOPMENT_QUALIFICATION records, authoritative control outputs, separately sealed family records, complete numerical-runtime/nested conformance objects, and exact arithmetic fixtures. Pre-evaluation and terminal intake/admission-failure records prohibit future evidence; evaluated records require the full bundle. Cross-record equality, chronology, recomputation, digest, bootstrap/Holm, numerical-runtime, authority, family-record, and transition invariants are enforced by the separately reviewed strict authority validator enumerated in x-strict-authority-validator; JSON Schema validation alone never grants qualification.

x-canonical-type-authority.rule: After local $ref and applicable allOf/oneOf/anyOf/if-then-else resolution, every canonicalized value must resolve to exactly one reviewed JSON type for that admitted instance. An explicit type is authoritative. A primitive const supplies exactly its JSON type; an enum supplies the unique JSON type matched by the admitted value; properties/required supply object; items/prefixItems supply array. integer and number are overlapping and may not both match. No other keyword or runtime value supplies type.
x-canonical-type-authority.audit_scope: All twelve x-hashed-object-projections objects plus the complete QUALIFICATION-HASHED-PROJECTIONS-02 outer fixture

x-hashed-object-projections.array_ordering: As specified in CONTRACT section 3.3.1; never object-key sorting or implementation iteration order

normative_fixture.field_values: The complete, type-directed values are frozen in CONTRACT section 3.3.2; aliases expand before validation and hashing and are not serialized.

x-forward-issuance-fixture.construction: Resolve the complete schema-valid synthetic records exactly as specified in CONTRACT section 3.3.3, then hash each step once in ascending order. Each candidate has a distinct content-derived UNADMITTED predecessor; no step may contain an identity from a later step; multiplicity and gates are recomputed; evaluated evidence is immutable into the terminal record.

required_invariants: QAV-01 every identity uses CONTRACT sections 3.3-3.3.2 QUALIFICATION_CANONICAL_JSON@1 and x-hashed-object-projections with the exact root/$defs type descriptor, digest domain, sole destination-field omission, explicit nulls and business array order; the canonical and hashed-projection byte/SHA fixtures and every nested digest recompute, while alternate field/domain/order/path/subdigest encodings refuse issuance

QAV-02 state equals transition.to_state; the prior sealed record has exactly transition.from_state and prior_qualification_id; only null->INTAKE_REJECTED, null->UNADMITTED->ADMITTED->QUALIFICATION_EVALUATED->QUALIFIED|REJECTED, or UNADMITTED->ADMISSION_REJECTED is legal; pre-evaluation and rejection records contain no future-stage evidence; intake_id, plain raw-intake digest, complete $defs/rejection_evidence projection, nullable missing identities/evidence, and rejection-evidence digest recompute without placeholders
QAV-03 only PRE_RANKING DEVELOPMENT_QUALIFICATION with INNER_SCORE folds from one study_plan_digest and one selection_run_id can become ranking eligible
QAV-04 fold windows are sorted and pairwise non-overlapping; session_id and valuation_date are globally unique; scored_sessions are strictly ordered and each belongs to exactly one fold/window

QAV-05 every fold has exactly one cash, buy-and-hold and matched control with equal Dataset/View/instrument/run/fold/window/capital/claim/cost identities; each complete $defs/authoritative_control_output validates and its kind-conditional explicit nulls, session-order arrays and output digest recompute

QAV-06 scored_session_set_digest validates against the complete ordered-array $defs/scored_session_set and every cash/pow, exposure/mean, matched affine, left-fold geometric aggregate/fold, edge, fold-fraction, effective-sample-size and component-level stress value recomputes under CONTRACT section 3.4 QUALIFICATION_BINARY64@1; both schema-bound input/output objects, every five-component MUL/FSUM/account intermediate, settlement/applicability fact and nextDown/equal/nextUp fixture match, while single-object, duplicate/reordered-session, aggregate/reordered/omitted/direct-subtraction/reassociated/FMA variants refuse issuance

QAV-07 the complete separately sealed $defs/family_record validates and contains full search/policy/stress/placebo/source/runtime/population evidence; inspected, covered, population and multiplicity candidate sets are identical strictly sorted sets with exactly one entry per inspected candidate; every population entry references only a prior ADMITTED or terminal ADMISSION_REJECTED qualification ID plus its role-valid nullable scored-session-set digest; the forward issuance fixture recomputes from distinct content-derived UNADMITTED predecessors without a placeholder, shared predecessor, identity mismatch, missing ancestry or backward terminal-record reference

QAV-08 candidate_multiplicity equals the one family entry whose digest equals candidate_digest; one-session admitted candidates emit NOT_TESTABLE/TOO_FEW_SESSIONS without bootstrap execution; raw p-values, all other NOT_TESTABLE states, deterministic Holm order and adjusted p-values recompute under CONTRACT section 5.6

QAV-09 gate states and reason_codes recompute from authoritative evidence; zero natural episodes serialize dependence_cluster_sizes=[] and effective_sample_size=0 without division; caller booleans never grant PASS

QAV-10 QUALIFIED requires every gate PASS and its own multiplicity entry ESTABLISHED with adjusted_p_value <= alpha; REJECTED requires at least one recomputed FAIL; every evidence, gate and reason field in a QUALIFIED or REJECTED record equals its immediately prior QUALIFICATION_EVALUATED record, so the terminal transition may change only qualification_id, state, ranking_eligible, ranking_status and transition as state semantics require

QAV-11 implementation_source_sha256 equals the installed reviewed study_qualification.py bytes and equals multiplicity.implementation_source_sha256; numerical_runtime is the complete schema-valid nested object, every loaded-object/CPU/auxv/loader/log1p/canonical/arithmetic subdigest recomputes under its exact domain, manifest_sha256 equals multiplicity.numerical_runtime_manifest_sha256, and the live process reproduces both arithmetic fixtures before issuance
QAV-12 OUTER_AUDIT and TERMINAL_HOLDOUT inputs are rejected by this schema/issuer and may only enter quant-platform/post-selection-evaluation@1
